description: This file contains implementation of MAPE (Mapping of Address and Port Encapsulation) configuration functions, including network tunnel setup, PSID calculation, and syscfg parameter management, within a WAN management system.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS WanManager_MAPEConfiguration(ipc_map_data_t * dhcp6cMAPEMsgBody,const WANMGR_IPV6_DATA * ipv6Data)
methods.description: Configures MAPE tunnel based on DHCPv6 MAP-E message, sets up network interfaces, and updates system configurations.

methods.name: INT WanManager_CalculateMAPEPsid(CHAR * pdIPv6Prefix,INT v6PrefixLen,INT v4PrefixLen,INT ea_length,USHORT * psidValue,UINT * ipv4IndexValue,UINT * psidLen)
methods.description: Calculates the PSID, IPv4 address suffix, and PSID length based on IPv6 prefix and EA length.

methods.name: VOID WanManager_MAPE_ResetSyscfgDefaults(VOID)
methods.description: Resets syscfg parameters related to MAPE configuration to their default state.
